info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Order Update API
info.description: The Market Order Update API allows for the modification of existing market orders within the wholesale trading system. This endpoint enables users to adjust key attributes of a market order, such as quantity or price parameters, ensuring that trading strategies can be fine-tuned based on market conditions. Typical consumers include trading firms and institutional investors, who need real-time adjustments to their orders to optimize execution. The API supports enhanced efficiency and responsiveness in managing trading operations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific market order identified by its resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary fields to be updated in the request payload.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the market order identified by 'RES-100045'. The body should contain the necessary fields that define the modifications to be made to the order. Please ensure that all required fields are included as per the operation specifications.
